steps.question: Does this call create or change project files through a script or text rewrite, such as node -e or python writing files (writeFileSync, write_text), sed -i, perl -pi, awk into a file, a heredoc, or a > or >> redirect into a project file, instead of the edit, write, or patch tools? Answer no when output goes only to a temporary file, a log, or /dev/null, or when a formatter, package manager, git, code generator, build or test writes the files.

then.text: Chauffeur: Change files with the edit, write, or patch tools, not scripts, heredocs, or redirects. They show the change and keep permission checks working.
